items.title: Smallest UK defined benefit schemes face steepest fiduciary management fee rises
items.summary: IC Select data shows standard fiduciary management fees for UK defined benefit schemes grew most for funds up to £50m up to December 2025.

items.title: ESG progress among investment funds falters in 2026, XPS research shows
items.summary: Research from XPS Group reveals a drop in the proportion of investment funds receiving a green ESG rating this year.

items.title: High Court rules Aviva can rely on disease-radius exclusion in Oxford colleges' COVID claim
items.summary: The High Court has ruled that Oxford University colleges cannot recover COVID-19 business interruption losses from Aviva due to an express exclusion clause.

items.title: Aon reports wider options and easing commercial insurance rates amid growing capacity
items.summary: Increased underwriting capacity and competition helped maintain favourable trading conditions and lower premium rates across several major commercial classes in the third quarter of 2026, according to Aon.

items.title: Lloyd’s of London creates unified oversight function under efficiency drive
items.summary: Lloyd’s of London is combining governance, performance, reserving and capital setting into a single oversight function led by Rachel Turk.

items.title: TPR finds formal governance lacking across small DC pension schemes
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has reported that only 27% of small defined contribution schemes maintain formal governance arrangements.
